text:
incident-bot: SLO alert — realtime.p99 > 2.5s in us-west-2 for 5m. auto-page to oncall. INC-1689007777. dashboard: https://grafana.company/realtime/p99?orgId=1
alice: I'm on it, joining bridge: https://meet.company/abc123
ben: Looking at grafana — p99 jumped ~800ms -> 3.2s @ ~13:10 UTC. p95 also up. Streaming stalls show tail spikes on kv-cache miss path.
carla: Any recent runtime deploys? deploy-bot shows canary at 12:59 (release/opt-quant).
ben: Can confirm canary traffic to model-x-quant8. KV cache evictions spiked on nodes serving that variant.
alice: Starting mitigations: pausing canary, routing 30% -> model-x-fallback, scale dedicated pool +2 nodes.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-1689007777 — page to alice (oncall).
dave: Customer impact: ~12 timeout tickets so far, mostly streaming responses. No data loss reported.
ben: Running quick checks: `curl -s http://metrics/kvcache | grep evictions` -> evictions=1284. Node heap stable.
carla: I'm rolling kernel selection back to stable on canary and applying kv cache threshold tweak.
ben: Applied KVCACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.8 on two pods, warming prefix cache now.
carla: Rolling config to 20% canary within 30s. if tail improves we'll expand.
ben: Early numbers — canary p99 down to ~920ms, p95 ~210ms. Warmup helping.
alice: Good — increase route split to 50% to shift traffic to warmed nodes.
ben: p99 across region trending ~980ms after shift. KV evictions rate dropping.
dave: Notifying affected customers: "We're investigating increased latency for streaming in US-WEST-2; mitigations in progress, no data loss." :email: 
alice: Hold bridge. We need 10m stable p99 <1s before fully closing.
carla: Observability note — added dashboard annotation + runbook link: https://confluence.company/runbooks/kv-cache-tail
alice: Update 8m: p99 stable ~950-1,000ms, evictions back to baseline. closing bridge in 10m if no regressions.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1689007777 marked resolved. Postmortem owners: ben, carla. Target: 48h.
